name: SOC 2 Type II
description: Service Organization Control 2 - Trust Services Criteria

trust_services_categories: CC6 - Logical and Physical Access Controls

controls.name: Control Environment - Integrity and Ethics
controls.description: The entity demonstrates a commitment to integrity and ethical values.

controls.name: Control Environment - Board Oversight
controls.description: The board of directors exercises oversight responsibility.

controls.name: Communication - Information Quality
controls.description: The entity obtains and uses quality information to support internal control.

controls.name: Risk Assessment - Objective Setting
controls.description: The entity specifies objectives with sufficient clarity.

controls.name: Monitoring - Control Evaluations
controls.description: The entity selects, develops, and performs ongoing evaluations.

controls.name: Control Activities - Selection and Development
controls.description: The entity selects and develops control activities that mitigate risks.

controls.name: Logical Access - Authentication
controls.description: The entity implements logical access security software, infrastructure, and architectures.

controls.name: Logical Access - Authorization
controls.description: Prior to issuing system credentials, the entity registers and authorizes internal and external users.

controls.name: Logical Access - Role-Based Access
controls.description: The entity implements role-based access controls.

controls.name: Logical Access - Access Removal
controls.description: The entity restricts access credentials to authorized users.

controls.name: Logical Access - Encryption
controls.description: The entity encrypts data during transmission and storage.

controls.name: Logical Access - Network Security
controls.description: The entity implements network security controls.

controls.name: Logical Access - Transmission Integrity
controls.description: The entity restricts the transmission of data to authorized parties.

controls.name: System Operations - Detection and Monitoring
controls.description: The entity detects and monitors unauthorized activities.

controls.name: System Operations - Incident Response
controls.description: The entity responds to identified security incidents.

controls.name: System Operations - Incident Recovery
controls.description: The entity recovers from identified security incidents.

controls.name: Change Management - Change Authorization
controls.description: The entity authorizes, designs, develops, implements, and tests changes.

controls.name: Change Management - System Testing
controls.description: The entity tests changes prior to implementation.

controls.name: Risk Mitigation - Risk Identification
controls.description: The entity identifies and assesses risks that may impact vendors and business partners.

controls.name: Risk Mitigation - Vendor Management
controls.description: The entity manages risks related to vendors and business partners.
